sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Stairs Races For 2 Players is a simple yet challenging game that requires strategy and quick reflexes. Each player controls a colored stickman character, Blue for Player 1 and Red for Player 2, with the goal of reaching the top of their staircase by collecting blocks of their own color and building or painting the steps.

The game starts with each player at the bottom of their staircase, with a set of blocks scattered around the level. Players must use the WASD keys or the touch screen joystick on the left for Player 1, and the arrow keys or the touch screen joystick on the right for Player 2, to move their character and collect the blocks.

As players collect blocks, they can use them to build or paint the steps of their staircase. The more blocks a player collects, the higher they can climb. The game also features a time limit, and the first player to complete their staircase and reach the finish platform wins the match.

The game's core mechanics are easy to learn, but mastering them requires practice and strategy. Players must balance speed and accuracy to collect blocks efficiently and avoid mistakes. This balance is what makes the game so addictive, as players must constantly adapt to the changing environment and their opponent's moves.

Whether you're a seasoned gamer or just starting out, the core gameplay mechanics of Stairs Races For 2 Players will keep you engaged and entertained for hours on end.
